name: Company report signals
description: Discover public report evidence relevant to account planning.

queryTemplates.name: annual-reports
queryTemplates.intent: Find newly published annual reports for {company} and retain the publisher's source URL and relevant passages.

signalRules.name: modernisation-investment
signalRules.interpretation: Identify explicit investment in IT modernisation and relate the finding to the company in the supplied project context. Distinguish announced intention from completed investment.
signalRules.recommendation: Recommend investigating an Initiative and Opportunity, with a rationale and the supporting passage. Do not infer that an opportunity is already qualified.
